desc: Prove that every balanced sequence of \(+\) and \(-\) positions has a noncrossing perfect matching whose pairs have opposite signs, using induction by removing adjacent opposite signs.

Establish the upper bound by orienting each matched pair according to its larger endpoint, then maximizing over \(k=\lfloor N/2\rfloor\) positive and \(k\) negative coefficients (with one zero coefficient when \(N\) is odd).
Show attainability by assigning \(+\) to the \(k\) largest values, \(-\) to the \(k\) smallest values, and leaving the remaining value unmatched when \(N\) is odd.
Implement the \(O(N\log N)\) stdin/stdout Python solution and check samples and edge cases.
